input: Find traditional general day camps summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville general day summer camps 2026 YMCA

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Traditional and teen day camps for rising grades 1–9 across city community centers; also therapeutic camps.

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Discovery, Explorer, Adventure and teen leadership camps in Asheville and surrounding communities; also Camp Watia overnight camp.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach offers classic day-camp activities and teen leadership programs; welcomes all backgrounds; 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Eliada Homes
candidates.note: West Asheville day camp for rising first graders through age 12, with swimming, games, trails and farm animals.

candidates.name: Evergreen Community Charter School
candidates.note: East Asheville Summer Adventures for rising K–9, with art, music, hiking, water play and climbing.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: Movers and Shakers summer camp offers themed weeks emphasizing community activities and sustainable living.

candidates.name: Asheville Sun Soo Martial Arts
candidates.note: Day camps for grades K–5 combine martial arts, games, projects and outdoor field trips.

candidates.name: Asheville Racquet Club
candidates.note: All Sports Camp offers full- and half-day options for ages 5–14; club locations include downtown and South Asheville.

candidates.name: Camp Cedar Cliff
candidates.note: East Asheville Christian day and overnight camps with swimming, archery, crafts, riding and outdoor activities.

candidates.name: Adventure Center of Asheville
candidates.note: West Asheville summer adventure day camps and separate Kolo Bike Park camps on its outdoor campus.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Asheville
candidates.note: FirstShine is a four-day summer camp for teens and young adults with special needs, including outings, games and crafts.

candidates.name: The Center for Inspired Education
candidates.note: Camp Summer Haven served ages 4–12 in 2025; official page currently says children's camps are taking a summer off.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: Summer camps for grades K–10 offer weekly animal, plant and outdoor-skills themes.

candidates.name: Asheville Farmstead School
candidates.note: Camp Farmstead offers six one-week themed farm-and-forest day-camp sessions.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: Outdoor summer day camps include games, crafts and wilderness skills; also teen overnight adventures for ages 12–17.

candidates.name: Arden Seventh-day Adventist Church of Arden
candidates.note: FLAG Camp is a Christian summer day camp for ages 5–12; operated weekdays June 15–July 31, 2026.

candidates.name: NovusWay Ministries
candidates.note: Lutheridge offers kindergarten–fourth-grade day camp, preschool camp and overnight youth programs; 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Recreation & Parks
candidates.note: Day camp for rising grades 1–6 at Grey Eagle Arena, with group games, swimming and local outings.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Montessori
candidates.note: Four weekly July camps with full- and half-day options, themed activities, art, water play and visitors.

candidates.name: Asheville Christian Academy
candidates.note: Summer day-camp offerings combine enrichment activities, sports, new skills and academic reinforcement.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Summer Clubs provide children's recreation programs; also weeklong youth conferences with worship and recreation.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Buncombe County 4-H
candidates.note: Summer Fun day camps offer cooking, agriculture, world cultures, art and other supervised learning activities.
